statements.t: In the Company Merger, each outstanding share of CSR common stock will be converted into 3.800 (the “Exchange Ratio”) newly issued shares of IRT common stock, par value $0.01 per share (“IRT common stock”), with cash paid in lieu of any fractional shares.
We currently expect the Mergers to close as early as the end of the fourth quarter of 2026.
We will consolidate the property into our financial results effective October 1, 2026.

Strategically renovating communities where there is the potential for outsized rent growth (our "Value Add Program") provides us with the opportunity to improve long-term growth through targeted unit and/or common area investments.
We intend to meet our liquidity requirements primarily through a combination of one or more of the following:
